'''Mo'rell''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Tarasin]], who lived on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].

==Biography==
Mo'rell was a member of the [[Jaraana irstat]] and he lived with them in a village in the jungles of Cularin. By the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] he was an elderly man. When the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Raik Muun]] set fire to the Jaraana irstat's village, Mo'rell was surrounded by burning rubble and the [[Heroes of Cularin]] attempted to rescue him.
